coreModule:
name = "moonbitlang/core"

version = "0.10.14+7d59c7ec9"

readme = "README.md"

repository = "https://github.com/moonbitlang/core"

license = "Apache-2.0"

keywords = [ "core", "standard library" ]

warnings = "+test_unqualified_package+unqualified_local_using+missing_doc+unnecessary_view_op+unnecessary_annotation+prefer_fixed_array+prefer_readonly_array-implicit_use_builtin+implicit_impl_as_method"
osRelease:
PRETTY_NAME="Debian GNU/Linux 13 (trixie)"
NAME="Debian GNU/Linux"
VERSION_ID="13"
VERSION="13 (trixie)"
VERSION_CODENAME=trixie
DEBIAN_VERSION_FULL=13.6
ID=debian
HOME_URL="https://www.debian.org/"
SUPPORT_URL="https://www.debian.org/support"
BUG_REPORT_URL="https://bugs.debian.org/"
cpuPinning: No taskset/affinity override; scheduler may migrate within allowed CPU set
host: virtualized shared cloud environment, not dedicated hardware
networkAndIDB: None used in benchmark; all fixtures/packets/binaries local
gc: Node default GC; no explicit GC or heap/optimization flags
concurrentWork: Parent reports all other local engineering jobs idle for build and timing window; host co-tenancy not controlled

dowdiness-alga.module:
name = "dowdiness/alga"

version = "0.4.0"

import {
  "moonbitlang/quickcheck@0.14.0",
}

readme = "README.md"

repository = "https://github.com/dowdiness/alga"

license = "Apache-2.0"

keywords = [
  "graph",
  "directed-graph",
  "algebraic-graphs",
  "algorithm",
  "trait",
]

description = "Algebraic graphs for MoonBit — directed graph trait and algorithm library inspired by Haskell's alga"

options(
  source: "src",
)

dowdiness-btree.module:
name = "dowdiness/btree"

version = "0.2.0"

import {
  "dowdiness/rle@0.2.2",
  "moonbitlang/quickcheck@0.14.0",
}

readme = "README.md"

repository = "https://github.com/dowdiness/canopy"

license = "Apache-2.0"

keywords = [ "btree", "data-structure", "counted-sequence" ]

description = "Generic counted B-tree with O(log n) indexed access, insert, delete, and range operations"

dowdiness-order-tree.module:
name = "dowdiness/order-tree"

version = "0.1.2"

import {
  "dowdiness/btree@0.2.0",
  "dowdiness/rle@0.2.3",
  "moonbitlang/quickcheck@0.14.0",
}

readme = "README.md"

repository = "https://github.com/dowdiness/order-tree"

license = "Apache-2.0"

keywords = [ "btree", "order-statistic", "data-structure" ]

description = "Order-statistic B-tree with O(log n) position-indexed operations"

dowdiness-rle.module:
name = "dowdiness/rle"

version = "0.2.3"

import {
  "moonbitlang/quickcheck@0.14.0",
}

readme = "README.md"

repository = "https://github.com/dowdiness/rle"

license = "Apache-2.0"

keywords = [ "rle", "run-length-encoding", "data-structure" ]

description = "Generic run-length encoded sequence with O(log n) position lookup"
